records.removed_exact_plumbing_utf8:
(* Replay-only plumbing added after the recorded execution. The exact executed
   source is archived in checks.executed-source.txt. Never replace its outputs. *)
If[AnyTrue[{"actual-output.txt", "actual-output.wxf"},
   FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{artifactDirectory, #}]] &],
  artifactDirectory = CreateDirectory[FileNameJoin[
    {artifactDirectory, "main-replay-" <> CreateUUID[]}]]];
If[!StringQ[artifactDirectory] || !DirectoryQ[artifactDirectory],
  Print["Cannot create a unique replay output directory; refusing exports."]; Abort[]];
